speaker: Doctor

Can you tell me how long you've been experiencing this cough and shortness of breath, and does the cough produce any mucus? 

REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Hyperinflation of the lungs, flattened diaphragms.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you for the X-ray results; the hyperinflation and flattened diaphragms are significant findings. Does your shortness of breath improve with rest, and do you experience wheezing or coughing up clear, white mucus? 

REQUEST TEST: Spirometry

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: FEV1: 65% of predicted, FVC: 75% of predicted, FEV1/FVC Ratio: 0.60 (decreased)

speaker: Doctor
text:
Have you noticed any seasonal patterns to your symptoms, and do you have a history of allergies or eczema?

REQUEST TEST: FeNO (Fractional exhaled Nitric Oxide)

speaker: Doctor
text:
Since your FeNO levels are normal, suggesting non-asthmatic airway inflammation, have you ever smoked or been exposed to significant secondhand smoke?

REQUEST TEST: Alpha-1 Antitrypsin Level

Additionally, do you experience morning stiffness in your joints or frequent sinus infections alongside your respiratory symptoms?

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD)
